rounds.response: Thanks, Alex — happy to help. For the QBR I recommend a 45–60 minute agenda: 1) Executive summary (goals vs current state), 2) Adoption & usage (active users, feature adoption, license utilization), 3) Process efficiency & outcomes (time-to-complete key workflows, error rates, time/cost savings), 4) Support/health signals (CSAT/NPS, incidents, top risks), 5) Roadmap & recommended next steps with clear owners and success metrics — I can send a ready-to-use slide template. For the onboarding workflow, best practices are: keep approvals minimal and role-based (use a single approver where possible), use staged approvals for complex flows, send grouped/digest notifications plus unobtrusive in-app badges, throttle non-critical alerts and define escalation rules for exceptions. To get the QBR on the calendar, please share 1) preferred 60-minute date windows in the next six weeks, 2) list of attendees and their roles, 3) top 3 business goals you want the QBR to address, and 4) access to current usage reports or a CSV export of last 90 days. Once you send those, I’ll share the slide template and a sample onboarding workflow diagram and propose three meeting slots.
